title: The Other Day (I met a bear)
transcription:
The Other Day
(I met a bear)

Leader/ Group:
The other day, (repeat)
I saw a bear
A great big bear,
A way up there

Together:
The other day,
I saw a bear,
A great big bear
a way up there

I looked at him, (repeat)
He looked at me
I sized up him,
He sized up me.

Together

And then he said (repeat)
Why don't you run,
I see you ain't
Got any gun.

Together

And so I ran
Away from there
But right behind
Me was that bear.

Together

Ahead of me,
I saw a tree,
A great big tree,
Oh, glory me.

Together

And so I jumped
Into the air.
But I missed that branch,
A way up there.

Together

Now don't you fret
And don't you frown
Cause I caught that branch,
On the way back down.

Together

That's all there is
There ain't no more,
Unless I meet
That bear once more.

Together
